text: 【世界黄金协会全球研究负责人：美联储重估与AI吸金夹击 东方买盘正重塑定价逻辑】世界黄金协会（WGC）美洲区首席执行官（CEO）兼全球研究负责人安凯表示，2026年年初至今黄金价格的剧烈波动，是多重宏观驱动力在不同阶段交替主导的结果。全球黄金市场的格局正在发生历史性的结构演变：以中国为代表的亚洲投资者与各大央行正展现出前所未有的支撑力量。黄金市场正在告别由西方单一主导的时代，向更加全球化、多元化的多极定价体系加速迈进。
text_en: [World Gold Council Global Research Head: Fed Reassessment and AI Cash Influx Combine, Eastern Buying Reshaping Pricing Logic] An Kai, CEO of the Americas and Global Research Head at the World Gold Council (WGC), stated that the severe volatility in gold prices so far in 2026 results from multiple macro drivers alternating dominance at different stages. The global gold market is undergoing a historic structural shift: Asian investors, represented by China, along with central banks, are showing unprecedented support. The gold market is bidding farewell to the era dominated solely by the West and accelerating towards a more globalized, diversified multi-polar pricing system.
